name: whatsapp-web
description: Use WhatsApp Web to log in, send messages, and receive/process WhatsApp replies via whatsapp-web.js.

PHONE_NUMBER.prompt: Optional phone number for WhatsApp pairing-code login, including country code.

DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE.prompt: Default country code used when normalizing local phone numbers.

HEADLESS.prompt: Run the WhatsApp browser session headless: true or false.

CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH.prompt: Optional path to Chrome/Chromium executable for WhatsApp Web.
